fusions.name: Tine and Away
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you use it. It holds 4 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Startling Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out at every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: First Bound
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward in one bound. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: White Tail Up
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
